name: Serve Robotics
flagship_product: Autonomous sidewalk delivery robot (Gen3); 'Maggie' conversational robot

financials.details: Publicly traded (Nasdaq: SERV); spun out of Uber/Postmates in 2021. Q1 2026 revenue $3.0M, up 238% sequentially and 578% YoY; reaffirmed ~$26M FY2026 revenue guidance. Largest US sidewalk-delivery fleet (2,000+ robots across 44 cities / 14 states). Acquired Diligent Robotics in 2026 to expand into indoor service robots.

Publicly traded (Nasdaq: ARBE); founded 2015 in Tel Aviv, went public in 2021 via SPAC. Reaffirmed 2026 revenue guidance of $4–6M and adjusted EBITDA loss of $(28)–$(31)M; ended Q1 2026 with $53.6M cash after an $18.5M registered direct offering. Partnering with NVIDIA on an AI perception platform; shipping radar chipsets to robotaxi / L4 programs.

Publicly traded (Nasdaq: ISRG); founded 1995, IPO 2000. The dominant surgical-robotics company. Q3 2025 revenue $2.51B (+23% YoY); da Vinci installed base 10,763 systems as of Sep 30, 2025 (+13% YoY). Dave Rosa became CEO July 1, 2025.

Publicly traded (Nasdaq: IRBT); founded 1990, pioneer of consumer home robots (Roomba). Launched its largest-ever product refresh in March 2025, but 2025 quarters fell below expectations amid market headwinds and production/shipping delays; the board is running a review of strategic alternatives (going-concern pressure). CEO Gary Cohen.

Publicly traded (Nasdaq: AVAV); founded 1971, IPO 2007. FY2025 revenue $820.6M (+14% YoY). Closed the BlueHalo acquisition May 1, 2025 (~$1.7B+ pro forma FY2025 revenue, +40% YoY). Two segments: Autonomous Systems (AxS) and Space, Cyber & Directed Energy (SCDE). CEO Wahid Nawabi.

Publicly traded (OUST); founded 2015, went public 2021 via SPAC. Publicly traded (Nasdaq: RR); headquartered in Las Vegas. FY2025 revenue $5.05M (+19% YoY). Targeting first fully autonomous excavator deployments in 2026.
